pb-support-desk.heading: Support queue
pb-support-desk.intro: You approve every reply and send it from the shop mailbox.
pb-support-desk.empty: Add a ticket from customer mail. You approve and send every reply yourself.
pb-support-desk.subject: Subject
pb-support-desk.confirmNote: Confirm this exact ticket before work starts. This proposal expires after half an hour.
pb-support-desk.person: A person is handling this ticket. Automatic drafts are paused.
pb-support-desk.policyChange: This reply changes a shop policy
pb-support-desk.shopApproval: Shop approval for a policy change
pb-support-desk.unsent: Nothing was sent. Send from the shop mailbox, then record it here.
pb-support-desk.selector: DKIM selector from your mail provider
pb-support-desk.lookup: A failed lookup does not mean the record is missing. Check the records with your mail provider.
pb-support-desk.error.generic: This did not finish. Review the ticket and try again.
pb-support-desk.error.TICKET_STALE: This ticket changed. Open it again before deciding.
pb-support-desk.error.TICKET_EXPIRED: This proposal expired. Review a fresh ticket.
pb-support-desk.error.TICKET_RUN_ACTIVE: Wait for the conversation run to stop before confirming.
pb-support-desk.error.TICKET_DUPLICATE: This conversation already has a ticket.
pb-support-desk.error.TICKET_NOTE_REQUIR: Add a note before resolving or closing this ticket.
pb-support-desk.error.TICKET_CLOSED: A closed ticket stays closed. Start a new conversation.
pb-support-desk.error.TICKET_TRANSITION_: That ticket move is not allowed.
pb-support-desk.error.SUPPORT_PERSON_REQ: A person is handling this ticket. Automatic drafts are paused.
pb-support-desk.error.SUPPORT_LANGUAGE_M: Use the customer language recorded on the ticket.
pb-support-desk.error.SUPPORT_NOT_DONE_Y: A request is not a completed money action. Saving a reply is not sending it.
pb-support-desk.error.SUPPORT_APPROVAL_R: Approve the exact reply before handing it off or recording a send.
pb-support-desk.error.SUPPORT_SHOP_APPRO: The shop must approve this exact policy change by its share link.
pb-support-desk.error.SUPPORT_CONFIRM_RE: Confirm the proposed ticket before working on it.
pb-support-desk.error.SUPPORT_SNOOZE_REA: Say why this ticket should wait.
pb-support-desk.error.SUPPORT_HOURS_INVA: Check the shop timezone, opening hours and response target.
pb-support-desk.error.SUPPORT_DOMAIN_INV: Choose a mail domain and its DKIM selector.
pb-support-desk.error.SUPPORT_SOURCE_REQ: A reply needs its language and the shop sources.
pb-support-desk.error.SUPPORT_RATING_EXI: This ticket already has its rating.
pb-support-desk.openingHint: Use Mon-Sat 10:00-19:00, or leave empty for always open.
pb-support-desk.ratingManual: Public rating links need the hosted app. Ask the customer and record their answer here.
pb-support-desk.error.SUPPORT_ORDER_REQU: Choose a shop service order before drafting.
pb-support-desk.error.SUPPORT_SOURCE_CHA: The shop files changed. Review a fresh reply.
pb-support-desk.dnsFix.MX: Ask your mail provider for the domain mail-exchanger records.
pb-support-desk.dnsFix.SPF: Add the SPF record supplied by your mail provider.
pb-support-desk.dnsFix.DKIM: Add the DKIM public key supplied for this selector.
pb-support-desk.dnsFix.DMARC: Ask your mail provider to help publish a DMARC policy.
pb-support-desk.matchUnknown: No confirmed match; ask for details
pb-support-desk.error.SUPPORT_MATCH_REQU: Choose a shop source row, or leave the match unconfirmed.
pb-support-desk.replyAddressHint: Use this as the reply address in your mail app. Downloaded drafts include it.
pb-support-desk.error.SUPPORT_THREAD_INV: Use a valid, short shop mailbox name for the reply address.
pb-support-desk.error.SUPPORT_REPLY_ADDR: The app signing key is unavailable. Reply in the existing mail conversation.
